name: slint-vscode
description: Lints SKILL.md files as you save them, with the source of every rule one hover away.

slint.path.description: The slint binary. An absolute path, or a name found on PATH.

enumDescriptions: Do not lint when saving a SKILL.md
Run static rules, then the model pass (uses your LLM settings)
slint.onSave.description: What to run when you save a SKILL.md: nothing, static only (no-llm), or static then model (llm). To also apply the computed fixes on save, set "editor.codeActionsOnSave" to { "source.fixAll.slint": "always" }.

slint.onType.description: Run static rules while typing a SKILL.md (debounced). Never runs the model.

slint.llm.provider.description: Model provider for the LLM rules (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, Ollama, Gemini, Anthropic). Overrides [llm].provider in slint.toml when set.

slint.llm.model.description: Model id the provider understands (e.g. llama-3.1-8b-instant on Groq). Overrides [llm].model when set.

slint.arguments.description: Extra arguments passed to slint, such as --rule name=off. Model-pass flags (--llm, --llm-provider, --llm-model, --llm-base-url, --llm-api-key-env) are reserved for the extension's own settings and are ignored here.

additionalProperties.description: Severity for this rule, or off.

body/hardcoded-repo-path.description: Do not hard-require consumer-repo paths without a missing-path fallback. (default: warning).

body/imperative-instructions.description: Write instructional steps as direct orders, not conversational or passive advice. (default: warning).

body/max-lines.description: Keep SKILL.md short enough to read end-to-end (about 500 lines max). (default: warning).

body/no-secret.description: Do not put API keys, passwords, or other secrets in the skill. (default: error).

body/no-time-bomb.description: Do not make instructions depend on calendar dates. (default: warning).

body/not-empty.description: SKILL.md must contain real instructions, not only headings. (default: error).

body/posix-paths.description: Use forward slashes in paths (scripts/foo.py), not backslashes. (default: warning).

body/relative-paths.description: Paths must be relative to the skill folder, not absolute machine paths. (default: warning).

body/token-budget.description: Keep the body within a reasonable token budget (~5000 tokens). (default: warning).

body/undeclared-tool.description: Host-specific tools in the body must be declared in allowed-tools or given a portable fallback. (default: warning).

bundle/contents-list.description: Long reference files should start with a table of contents. (default: info).

bundle/declared-dependencies.description: Third-party packages a script imports must be named in the install instructions. (default: warning).

bundle/executable-script.description: Scripts that start with a shebang (#!) must be marked executable. (default: warning).

bundle/flat-references.description: Link bundled files from SKILL.md, not only from other bundled files. (default: warning).

bundle/no-dangling-path.description: Every path mentioned in the instructions must exist in the skill folder. (default: error).

bundle/script-prerequisites.description: Skills that ship scripts must document runtime needs in a Prerequisites section. (default: warning).

bundle/unused-file.description: Every file in the skill folder should be referenced from the instructions (or another linked file). (default: warning).

description/concrete-noun.description: The description should name concrete tools, formats, or systems users would mention. (default: info).

description/max-length.description: Keep the description at or under 1024 characters. (default: error).

description/min-length.description: The description must be long enough to explain what the skill does and when to use it. (default: warning).

description/no-markup.description: The description must be plain text — no HTML or Markdown tags. (default: error).

description/not-just-name.description: The description must add information beyond repeating the skill name. (default: warning).

description/present.description: Every skill must have a description in the frontmatter. (default: error).

description/says-when.description: The description must say when to use the skill. (default: warning).

description/third-person.description: Write the description in the third person (\ (default: warning).

frontmatter/compatibility-max-length.description: Keep the compatibility field at or under 500 characters. (default: error).

frontmatter/key-format.description: Frontmatter keys should be lowercase with hyphens (no spaces). (default: info).

frontmatter/present.description: SKILL.md must start with a YAML frontmatter block (--- ... ---). (default: error).

frontmatter/type-error.description: name and description must be YAML strings. (default: error).

frontmatter/unknown-field.description: Top-level frontmatter keys must be agentskills.io fields, Claude Code extensions, or live under metadata. (default: warning).

llm/consistent-terminology.description: Use one name for each concept everywhere in the skill. (default: warning).

llm/default-choice.description: When several approaches are listed, mark which one to use by default. (default: info).

llm/failure-path.description: Steps that can fail say what to do when they fail. (default: info).

llm/no-ambiguity.description: Every instruction has one clear meaning; none contradict another. (default: warning).

llm/no-known-context.description: Do not explain things a capable model already knows. (default: warning).

llm/output-example.description: When the output format matters, show a concrete example. (default: info).

llm/specificity-matches-risk.description: Risky steps get precise instructions; judgement calls stay flexible. (default: warning).

llm/trigger-coverage.description: The description matches how users would actually ask for this skill. (default: warning).

name/format.description: Skill names must be lowercase, use hyphens, and be at most 64 characters. (default: error).

name/matches-directory.description: The name in the frontmatter must match the skill folder name. (default: warning).

name/no-reserved-word.description: Do not put reserved vendor words (like anthropic or claude) in the skill name. (default: error).

name/not-generic.description: The skill name should describe what the skill does. (default: warning).

project/consistent-naming-style.description: Skill names in the same project should follow one naming convention. (default: info).

project/distinct-descriptions.description: Skill descriptions in the same project should not sound like the same offer. (default: warning).

project/unique-name.description: No two skills in the project may share the same name. (default: error).
